title: Preserve max_tokens on legacy prompt-form completions
goal: Carry a validated legacy /v1/completions max_tokens budget into the normalized GEMI provider request so local and OpenAI-compatible completion engines stop at the caller's requested limit.

checks.cmd: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p susi-server -p susi-gemi -p susi-adapters-llm --all-targets -- -D warnings
SUSI_LOCAL_TEST_RUNNER=serial cargo run --offline --locked -p xtask --bin local-workflow -- check

results.behavior: Legacy prompt requests with a validated max_tokens value now carry one normalized user turn and the caller budget into GEMI; budgetless legacy requests retain their existing prompt-only path; OpenAI-compatible completion requests use the carried budget and retain a 2048 fallback.

limitations: Legacy prompt-form completions continue to refuse caller-supplied tools and retain their existing prompt-only response shape.
No live provider credentials or model files are used; native Windows qualification remains a separate host task.
